tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; the default ground for every section.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section band and card fill; separates sections by tone, never by a border.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs and cards that sit on surface-alt.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted band (hero, footer, closing CTA) — flips per theme so the contrast moment survives in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, metadata and captions on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (≥6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around cards; decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (≥3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single brand accent: primary button fill, links, focus ring, active states. As text on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text (tags, highlighted stat).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring — alias of accent, 2px solid with a 3px offset.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text with a word or icon; on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a message; orange, not red, so it separates from success by more than hue.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. 56px below 768px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Powered by AI and brought together as one.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display or h1; max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Our expertise helps businesses unlock growth.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a heading; set in capitals.

spacing.note: 8px base with a deliberately long top end: premium comes from the big steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), stacked form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Heading to body copy; grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button padding (horizontal) at large size; grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section header to section content.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding (top and bottom) on desktop — the default rhythm.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero and closing CTA padding on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding ≥1024px (24px below 768px).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; text columns stay narrower (68ch).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and media.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and inverse bands inset in the page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips — always pills.

shadow.note: The system is flat; one shadow only, for floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs only; never on cards.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: All hover and reveal transitions.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and colour transitions.
